title: SUP-MIMIC: A Multi-Task Clinical Diagnosis Benchmark for Evaluating LLMs' Robustness to Contradictory Evidence
abstract: arXiv:2608.29582v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Current evaluations of large language models (LLMs) primarily focus on factual knowledge retrieval, overlooking the fundamental challenge of navigating the complex, non-bijective mappings between clinical indicators and diagnoses. Existing benchmarks fail to assess whether large language models truly possess the reasoning capability required for diagnostic ambiguity scenarios, where identical clinical presentations may correspond to different etiologies, and diagnostic convergence scenarios, where heterogeneous symptoms ultimately indicate the same disease. To address this issue, we propose SUP-MIMIC, a multi-task framework utilizing MIMIC-IV-v3.1 that comprises Basic Assessment (BA), Diagnostic Divergence Task (DDT), and Diagnostic Convergence Task (DCT). translated_title: SUP-MIMIC：用于评估大语言模型对矛盾证据鲁棒性的多任务临床诊断基准
translated_abstract: 当前对大语言模型的评估主要集中于事实性知识的检索，忽视了在临床指标与诊断之间复杂的、非一一对应（非双射）映射中进行推断这一根本性挑战。现有基准无法评估大语言模型是否真正具备应对诊断模糊场景和诊断趋同场景所需的推理能力——在诊断模糊场景中，相同的临床表现可能对应不同的病因；而在诊断趋同场景中，异质性的症状最终可能指向同一种疾病。为解决这一问题，我们提出了SUP-MIMIC，这是一个基于MIMIC-IV-v3.1的多任务框架，包含基础评估、诊断分歧任务和诊断趋同任务。具体而言，诊断分歧任务旨在评估模型在表型相似病例之间的“一对多”消歧能力，而诊断趋同任务则评估模型识别……
tldr: 提出了基于MIMIC-IV-v3.1的多任务临床诊断基准SUP-MIMIC，通过诊断分歧任务和诊断趋同任务评估大语言模型在临床指标与诊断之间非一一对应映射下应对矛盾证据的推理鲁棒性。
en_tdlr: SUP-MIMIC is a multi-task clinical diagnosis benchmark built on MIMIC-IV-v3.1 that evaluates LLMs' robustness to contradictory evidence through Diagnostic Divergence and Diagnostic Convergence tasks, addressing the non-bijective mapping between clinical indicators and diagnoses.
